evidence.observation: Distillate flow decayed from 0.215 to ~0.01 L/h, essentially stopped
Reflux flow also collapsed (0.235 -> 0.005-0.124 L/h), erratic
Ratio stuck cycling among a few discrete values (3.64/3.90/2.93) inconsistent with measured FT703/FT704
Upper-column temperatures rising steadily (T712 51->87 °C), heavy ends breaking through toward the top
Reboiler reads ~380-386 °C, implausibly high versus T702 ~115 °C, suggesting sensor offset

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/condenser sample composition, and verification of FT703/FT704 and T701 calibration (plus condenser duty/vacuum status) to distinguish loss of takeoff from flow-sensor failure
